rationale: C09 plausibly supplied a material template for explaining the purpose and scope of a presidential commission: it calls for a broad review, states that the review should provide a basis for later action, situates the commission's work within domestic and international policy, and connects national economic policy to free-world strength and living standards. The child adapts that machinery to the broader Commission on National Goals, asking it to identify major issues and objectives as the basis for coordinated domestic and international policies. C17 has related future-oriented study and policy-coordination language, while C10 shares the emphasis on long-term planning amid technological and international change, but neither matches the commission framework as closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Commission on National Goals is being asked to identify the great issues of our generation and describe our objectives in these various areas. To do so will be to give us the basis for coordinated policies in both the domestic and international areas.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I now recommend that a commission be established to make this review. The review should provide the basis for action during the next session of the Congress.
shared_material.explanation: Both describe a presidential commission conducting a broad review whose findings will furnish the basis for subsequent policy or action.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Commission undoubtedly will want to consider how within a framework of free decision-making our economy can best be developed to meet the Communist challenge and simultaneously progress toward established goals.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This commission naturally should work within the framework of our foreign policy and our global defense plans.
shared_material.explanation: Both place the commission's inquiry within an overarching policy framework linking economic development to the international Communist challenge.

shared_material.child_excerpt: One American aspiration is to develop a world in which all peoples will be living at peace under cooperative policies with maximum standards of living and opportunity for all.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In launching a broad-gauge study into the question of what our foreign economic policy should be, I think we can prepare the way for a fuller utilization of the economic strength of the free world in the cause of peace and prosperity.
shared_material.explanation: The child broadens C09's commission rationale but retains its linkage among policy study, economic strength, peace, and prosperity.
